title: Determinants of Starting Salaries for Filipino Graduates: An Explainable Machine Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.21383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Filipino graduates face a persistent disconnect between educational preparation and labor market outcomes, where starting salary is a key signal of entry-level valuation. Current Philippine research is dominated by descriptive tracer studies that document employment rates but do not explain the determinants of pay. We address this gap using a crowd-sourced survey dataset of graduate responses whose noisy, self-reported nature makes it a challenging prediction target. Applying machine learning to this problem, we identify job role and industry as the dominant determinants of starting salary, significantly outweighing institutional prestige. The strength of this finding is its central contribution: it is corroborated by three independent lines of evidence, namely SHAP attributions, the heavy reliance of the best ensemble on occupational text, and a Natural Language Inference reformulation. translated_title: 菲律宾毕业生起薪的决定因素：一种可解释的机器学习方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21383v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：菲律宾毕业生面临教育准备与劳动力市场结果之间的持续脱节，其中起薪是入门级价值评估的关键信号。当前菲律宾的研究主要局限于描述性追踪研究，这些研究记录了就业率，但未解释薪酬的决定因素。我们通过使用众包调查数据集来填补这一空白，该数据集包含毕业生回应，其噪声大、自我报告的性质使其成为一个具有挑战性的预测目标。将机器学习应用于此问题，我们发现工作角色和行业是起薪的主要决定因素，其重要性显著超过机构声望。这一发现的强度在于其核心贡献：它得到了三条独立证据线的证实，即SHAP归因、最佳集成模型对职业文本的严重依赖，以及自然语言推理重构。这些结果表明，职业指导和公共政策应优先关注职业路径和行业选择，而非仅关注机构品牌。
tldr: 本研究通过可解释机器学习发现，工作角色和行业是菲律宾毕业生起薪的主要决定因素，其影响远超机构声望，并经三条独立证据线验证。
en_tdlr: This study reveals via explainable machine learning that job role and industry are the dominant determinants of starting salaries for Filipino graduates, outweighing institutional prestige, as corroborated by three independent evidence lines.
